biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: Delays in Volkswagen's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) postpone the rollout of next-generation EV body-in-white architectures and integrated structural battery crash load paths. This schedule change impacts Audi's deployment of scalable lightweight body structures across its future midsize EV lineup.

biw_news.title: Maserati’s Next Electric Cars Could Be A Large GT And SUV: Report
biw_news.summary: Developing high-performance electric GT and SUV models on shared EV architectures requires tailored body-in-white structural reinforcements to achieve requisite torsional rigidity and crash safety. Distributed assembly between overseas production and final finishing demands strict dimensional management of the body shell.
